summary: Concept-level explainer for the navigation layer: a two-column 'temperature' figure splitting what the index keeps exact (paths, symbols, imports, calls) from what it leaves to the model, then three panels for the map, find and gs. The seam between the columns is a plain 1px gradient div, not an SVG stroke — a rough-filtered wavy stroke was tried first and read as a stray scratch at this size. Same page shell as its sibling: docs.css + how.css, SvgDefs, Nav/Footer variant 'how'.
